capabilities: Upload the whole vault as a zip snapshot to a WebDAV server
Restore a selected remote snapshot or backup
Create and upload a safety backup before restoring remote content
Split large archives into chunked WebDAV uploads
Clean up old snapshots according to a retention count
disambiguation: Despite its name, it is not a sync tool: it does no incremental synchronization, conflict resolution, merging, or automatic direction decisions.
extras: Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese). The README warns that enabling configuration backup may include WebDAV credentials in snapshots and that passwords/tokens are stored in plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to back up an entire vault as zip snapshots to a user-owned WebDAV server with a safe manual restore flow.
summary: Manual full-vault snapshot backup and restore to a user-configured WebDAV server, with a forced safety backup before every restore.
